mail_of: 2026-10-05; second batch is mail of 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07
masking: [NAME] person, [ORG] company or product, [EMAIL], [PHONE], [DATE] absolute date, [IMAGE] inline image. Weekday words and relative times kept because the engine reads them.
labels_note: Labels were assigned by a model reading the real text and are NOT checked by the owner. Every number is "agrees with a careful model on real text". n is tiny. These sentences are evaluation only: do not train on them. Cases with confidence "unsure" stay in the file and out of headline precision and recall.

source_kinds.real_other: written by another real person (customer, prospect, auto-responder)
source_kinds.real_own: written by the owner's side for real business
source_kinds.dogfood_test: written by the owner or his agents as a product test; report separately, never mix into real recall

label_map: ASK / PROMISE / SILENT are the shipped pipeline (unsure, INFORM and ACK count as SILENT: no loop). HOLD / CLOSE are classifyReply on a waiting loop (closed, paid and declined are CLOSE; every other outcome holds). close_as, when set, requires that outcome (a done-close is not a declined-close). reply_label, when set on an intent row, is the waiting-loop class as well. direction incoming vs own is who wrote the sentence. dogfood_test is never mixed into the real-only line. confidence unsure is excluded from headline numbers.

cases.context: incoming reply to the owner's open ask
cases.text: רק היום חזרתי מחופשת החג – מקווה לשלוח לך משהו יותר מפורט במהלך השבוע.
cases.label: HOLD
cases.expected: HOLD: the owner's ask stays open (Waiting on). It is the other person's hedged promise with a this-week horizon; must not close the loop.

cases.text: תודה, ושמחים שחזרת. מחכים לפירוט כשיהיה לך נוח.
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT: no new loop and no card; the existing Waiting-on loop stays open.

cases.context: incoming, addressed by name to a third-party colleague; the owner is also in To
cases.text: עדכני אם משהו לא נראה לך או אשרי כדי שאתן ל[NAME] מחברת [ORG] אור ירוק.
cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT for the owner: the imperative is addressed to a colleague (feminine singular, named greeting), not to the owner. No Do It card.

cases.label: SILENT
cases.expected: SILENT or at most a soft loop: conditional ask ('tell me only if it is not detailed enough'); weight-of-intention says a soft conditional ask opens no card.

cases.context: incoming reply to the owner's cold outreach meeting ask
cases.text: שלום, נושא זה אינו בטיפולי ולא בסמכותי. אנא פנה אל מנהל האגף למערכות מידע ב[ORG]. תודה, [NAME]
